Package dev.visdb.seesaw.models

package dev.visdb.seesaw.models
This package contains some very different kinds of model.
  • models which manage a collection of objects to/from a database
  • models, some derived from java.swing, for use with UI components

Database Collection Models

These models abstract away the storage specifics; they all implement DbCollection. they generally read and write to database. There are subclasses that present data as an array or set independent of how it might be stored in a data. A model could represent data from a single field or data resulting from a join.

UI support Models

These models, sub-classes of AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel, generally revolve around managing ListItems. An ListItem is generally the item which is visible in a JComboBox or JList. Additionally these classes implement ListModel and MutableComboBoxModel; they can be installed into either. GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo works with GlazedLists auto completion.
